predictions.symptom: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'get') at updateDiParent in BpmnUpdater.js when morphing a DataStoreReference to a DataObjectReference outside of a pool.
predictions.expected_behavior: Either disallow morphing DataStoreReference to DataObjectReference outside of a pool, or allow the morph operation to succeed without error.
predictions.uncertainty: The issue presents two alternative resolutions (disallow morphing vs allow morph without error); clarification is required to determine the desired design policy.

questions: Should morphing a DataStoreReference to a DataObjectReference outside of a Pool be disallowed (e.g. via replace rules), or should the morph operation be allowed and handled without throwing an error?

predictions.symptom: Diagram jumps when wrapping a process in a pool.
predictions.uncertainty: Whether the jump is caused by canvas root element replacement in makeCollaboration, canvas auto-scroll during moveElements, or diagram-js viewbox recalculation on root change.

questions: Should the canvas viewbox/scroll position be preserved explicitly across modeling.makeCollaboration(), or should canvas.scrollToElement / canvas.viewbox restore the prior viewport state?

predictions.symptom: When switching planes while direct editing is active inside a sub-process plane, the direct editing box remains open even though the element is no longer visible.
predictions.expected_behavior: Direct editing is canceled or completed when switching planes.
predictions.uncertainty: The issue requests cancel on plane switch, but completing vs canceling on root change may have differing design implications.

questions: Should switching planes cancel direct editing (discarding unsaved changes) or complete direct editing (committing current input before changing root)?

predictions.symptom: The deep linking overlay for the subprocess is lost when using the multi-diagram plugin alongside deep linking functionality in bpmn-js and Camunda Modeler 5.0.
predictions.expected_behavior: Drilldown overlays for subprocesses should persist or be restored when navigating between different processes/diagrams and subprocesses within the same BPMN file.
predictions.uncertainty: Unclear whether multi-diagram navigation is intended to be supported as core bpmn-js behavior or if root change event hooks should be exposed/handled for drilldown overlays.

questions: How does the multi-diagram plugin perform process/diagram switching (e.g., does it call canvas.setRootElement or swap entire definitions/diagram instances)?
Should DrilldownOverlayBehavior re-evaluate and re-add drilldown overlays on root element changes (e.g., 'root.set') rather than only on 'import.done'?

predictions.symptom: When the label of a Task is removed, the DI object still retains the `label` property with a value of `null` (`di.label` exists as `null`).
predictions.expected_behavior: The `label` property (`di.label`) does not exist on the DI object after clearing the label/name.
predictions.uncertainty: Whether deleting the property via `delete di.label` or setting it to undefined is the preferred convention across the codebase.

questions: Should `di.label` be explicitly deleted (`delete di.label`) or set to `undefined` when the label text is cleared, and does moddle or the XML exporter require specific handling for removed DI attributes?

predictions.uncertainty: Whether properties should be preserved via in-place mutation of isSequential or copying properties between instances when changing loop types.

questions: When switching between parallel and sequential MultiInstanceLoopCharacteristics, should existing properties (e.g. loopCardinality, isSequential, completionCondition) be preserved on the existing instance by just updating `isSequential`, or should a new object clone existing properties?

predictions.symptom: When applying color specifically to an external label using `modeling.setColor`, the external label is set to the "fill" color instead of the "stroke" color.
predictions.expected_behavior: External labels should be set to the "stroke" color, matching the behavior of embedded labels.
predictions.uncertainty: Whether 'stroke' should be strictly used or if fallback to 'fill' is expected when only 'fill' is provided in colors.

questions: Should external label color prioritize 'border-color' (stroke) when both fill and stroke are provided, or fall back to 'background-color' if only fill is specified?

questions: Should connection labels and connected associations be updated automatically via connection.layout / connection.updateWaypoints interceptors, or should shape.resize explicitly trigger layout/adjustment for incoming and outgoing connections and their attached elements?
